text:
Alex Carter: Hey team - Solara Health asked for a concentrated enablement week ahead of their scaling test. They signaled renewal decision in ~30 days and want confidence on latency + cost. Need to lock agenda and times by EOD Friday.
Priya Nair: Thanks Alex. Proposed slots? Solara spans US-East, EMEA, APAC. I suggest 3 buckets to cover overlap: 0800 PT, 1400 PT, 2300 PT. Can we pick one primary and one optional?
Mateo Ruiz: I can own the technical deep dives on Dedicated/GPU profiles. Prefer 1400 PT for engineering-heavy session so engineers can attend. Will prep a 30-min kernel/quantization demo.
Jenna Park (Solara CS): Client asks for shorter segments, 45 min max ideally. Can we split into 'overview' + 'lab' so attendees opt into hands-on? Also need SSO and SOC2/KMS discussion.
Alex Carter: OK — draft agenda (flexible):
```
1) 15m - Overview & renewal Qs (CS)
2) 10m - Cost optimization quick wins (CS/Eng)
3) 30m - Dedicated performance & latency tuning (Eng)
4) 30m - Optional hands-on lab + Qs (SE)
5) 15m - Security/KMS & next steps (Security)
```
Keep total ~100m but make lab optional to respect 45m preference.
Priya Nair: I'll publish a poll for the 3 slots and sync with calendar. Jenna - do they prefer a specific weekday?
Jenna Park (Solara CS): Prefer Tue or Wed mornings CET. Also flagged: legal will ask about Dedicated baseline in contract amendment — want talking points ready.
Alex Carter: Renewal risk flagged: CSM health score ~6/10 due to cost concerns. Include 'cost optimization' 10-min segment and follow-up doc with batching/quantization profiles + expected $/1k tokens delta.
Mateo Ruiz: I'll add a short demo showing token-cost delta with batching + quantization. Sample benchmark command I'll run for lab prep:
```
# local benchmark
python bench.py --model redwood-dedicated --batch 8 --quant 4bit
```
Will produce charts and a 1-pager.
Priya Nair: Poll posted: https://cal.poll/solara-enable — responses due by Friday 12pm PT. Calendar-bot created a provisional event.
calendar-bot: Event created: 'Solara Enablement Week - Provisional' 2026-04-07 14:00 PT (placeholder) :calendar: 
Alex Carter: Action items assigned:
- @Mateo Ruiz: prepare demo + 1-pager on perf & cost comparisons
- @Priya Nair: run poll, create calendar invites, compile pre-reads
- @Jenna Park (Solara CS): consolidate client questions + attendee list
- @security-team: prep brief KMS/SOC2 blurb for last 15m
Any blockers?
Mateo Ruiz: All good, will confirm infra for lab seats and upload artifacts by Mon EOD.
Jenna Park (Solara CS): I'll send list of ~8 attendees and their roles tomorrow morning CET.
Priya Nair: I'll also create a short post-session feedback form (1-5 enablement score + 3 quick comments) to capture immediate signals for renewal health.
Alex Carter: If we see <=4 from key stakeholders, escalate to AM and prepare pricing options.
Jenna Park (Solara CS): Thanks team, appreciate the fast turnaround :thumbsup:
